달러.require: Explicit US dollars; no assumed currency

numeric_policy.percent_scale: 15 percent stays 15 PERCENT; 0.15 is not multiplied without explicit ratio convention
numeric_policy.year_month_conversion: No automatic conversion: calendar/age conventions differ
numeric_policy.currency_conversion: No exchange-rate conversion; currency must be explicit

unit_state.transport: Current unit:null cannot encode NONE vs UNKNOWN alone; keep sidecar provenance. New persisted state field needs schema approval.

range.legacy_conversion: minimum/maximum or min/max may convert ONLY when both boundary flags and metric/unit/basis are explicit and identical
range.unbounded: Use explicit GT/GTE/LT/LTE for one-sided ranges; no invented bound

categorical.single: EQ/NEQ scalar string; preserve original label
categorical.multiple: IN/NOT_IN nonempty alternatives, not arbitrary comma-splitting
categorical.array_logic: IN alternatives only when source establishes OR membership; separate requirements require explicit AST
categorical.codes: Namespace/version/source label required; no guessed code
categorical.status_boolean: EQ true/false is distinct from EXISTS/NOT_EXISTS; never coerce EXISTS true to null automatically

region.canonical_level: Explicit administrative level and authoritative namespace/version if available
region.exact_alias_candidate: Only validated unambiguous geographic ID; short city label alone may be ambiguous
region.NO_RESTRICTION: Explicit absence of geographic requirement; retain as source assertion sidecar, not a positive region condition or UNKNOWN
region.UNKNOWN: Geographic restriction cannot be established; distinct from NO_RESTRICTION
region.NATIONWIDE: Explicit scope is not necessarily absence of all geographic requirements
region.transport: No new runtime enum is introduced; novel source assertions need downstream versioned contract approval

temporal.date: YYYY-MM-DD with real calendar validation, original precision retained
temporal.reference: Existing reference_date/date_type and temporal_constraint anchor must be preserved
temporal.unknown_anchor: Never substitute current date, publication date, or collection time
temporal.application_date: APPLICATION temporal anchor is distinct from APPLICATION_START reference date; require explicit basis
temporal.phases: evaluation_phase/fulfillment_phase/requirement_kind remain independent; do not flatten future obligations to current facts

schema_compatibility: Existing range structure retained. New unit_status/region assertion states are sidecar draft only.
